title: davallia hookeri
intro: Davallia hookeri, commonly known as Hooker's fern, is a species of fern in the family Davalliaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Davallia hookeri include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain, improve immune function, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
